item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk's Resignation: The Only Way to Save Conservatism (장동혁 사퇴, 보수 살리는 유일한 길)
item.description:
Politics is a competition of who does better. If you are even slightly better than your opponent, you win the election. Conversely, it's also a competition of who is less incompetent. Even if you are not good, if your opponent is worse than you, you win the election. (정치는 누가 누가 잘하나 경쟁입니다. 경쟁 상대보다 내가 조금이라도 더 잘하면 선거에서 이깁니다. 반대로 누가 누가 덜 못 하나 경쟁이기도 합니다. 내가 못해도 경쟁 상대가 나보다 더 못하면 선거에서 이깁니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung seems to understand this nature of politics. In May 2025, amid the turmoil over the People Power Party's presidential candidate change, he introduced a remark by former President Kim Young-sam: "In politics, it's not about us doing well. If we just stay still, the other side will fall flat on their face. Then we win." (정치의 이런 속성을 이재명 대통령도 아는 것 같습니다. 2025년 5월 국민의힘 대선 후보 교체 파동을 보고 “정치는 우리가 잘한다고 되는 게 아니라, 가만히 있으면 상대방이 자빠진다. 그러면 우리가 이기는 것이다”라는 김영삼 전 대통령의 말을 소개한 일이 있습니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung's recent job performance ratings are not bad. In a regular Gallup Korea poll released on July 10th, positive approval of the president's job performance was 53%, and negative approval was 35%, similar to the week before. Positive responses that the three major mega-projects "will contribute to balanced regional development" were 57%, while negative responses that "regional disparities will widen further" were 26%. (최근 이재명 대통령 직무 평가는 나쁘지 않습니다. 7월10일 발표한 한국갤럽 정례 여론조사에서 대통령 직무 긍정 평가는 53%, 부정 평가는 35%로 1주일 전과 비슷했습니다. 3대 메가 프로젝트가 “지역 균형 발전에 도움이 될 것”이라는 긍정적 응답은 57%, “지역 간 격차가 더 커질 것”이라는 부정적 응답은 26%였습니다.)

However, the government's real estate policy is approaching a dangerous level. The rise in jeonse (lump-sum deposit) and monthly rents is severe. The Democratic Party is absorbed in internal power struggles, turning its back on people's livelihoods. (하지만 정부의 부동산 정책은 위험 수위에 다가서고 있습니다. 전·월세 상승은 심각합니다. 민주당은 민생을 외면한 채 당권 투쟁에 몰두하고 있습니다.)

Despite this, the gap in party support is large, with the Democratic Party at 42% and the People Power Party at 24%. Democratic Party support has not dropped from 41% immediately after the June 3rd election. People Power Party support, which rose to 29% right after the election, has been on a downward trend to 27%, 26%, and 24%. They have squandered all the support gained from winning the Seoul mayoral election. The People Power Party's support seems likely to fall further. There are two reasons. (그런데도 정당 지지도는 민주당 42%, 국민의힘 24%로 차이가 큽니다. 민주당 지지도는 6·3 선거 직후 41%에서 떨어지지 않고 있습니다. 국민의힘 지지도는 선거 직후 29%로 올라갔다가 27%, 26%, 24%로 내리막입니다. 서울시장 선거 승리로 얻은 지지도를 다 까먹은 것입니다. 국민의힘 지지도는 앞으로 더 빠질 것 같습니다. 이유는 두 가지입니다.)

First, the Yoon Seok-youl effect. (첫째, 윤석열 효과입니다.)

Former President Yoon Seok-youl is on trial for several cases. Just when the public is about to forget, former President Yoon Seok-youl's face appears on television. Whenever former President Yoon Seok-youl's face is seen, the People Power Party's support is bound to drop. (윤석열 전 대통령은 여러 개 사건으로 재판을 받고 있습니다. 국민이 잊을만하면 윤석열 전 대통령 얼굴이 텔레비전에 나타납니다. 윤석열 전 대통령 얼굴이 보일 때마다 국민의힘 지지도는 떨어질 수밖에 없습니다.)

On July 9th, the Supreme Court confirmed the lower court's sentence of seven years in prison for former President Yoon Seok-youl's obstruction of the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO). On the same day, former Presidential Security Service Chief Park Jong-joon, former Deputy Chief Kim Seong-hoon, and former Security Headquarters Chief Lee Kwang-woo, among other security service officials who obstructed the arrest, were also sentenced to prison terms in the first trial for special obstruction of public duty and were detained in court. (대법원은 7월9일 윤석열 전 대통령의 고위공직자범죄수사처 체포 방해 사건에 대해 징역 7년의 원심을 확정했습니다. 같은 날 박종준 전 경호처장, 김성훈 전 차장, 이광우 전 경호본부장 등 체포를 방해한 경호처 간부들도 특수공무집행방해 사건 1심에서 모두 실형을 선고받고 법정 구속됐습니다.)

Do you remember the 44 People Power Party lawmakers who gathered in front of the Hannam-dong presidential residence on January 6, 2025, vowing to prevent President Yoon Seok-youl's arrest? Since the Supreme Court has finally recognized the obstruction of arrest as a crime, I believe these individuals should apologize to the public even now. Yet, they are feigning ignorance and staying silent. It seems they have absolutely no sense of shame. (여러분은 2025년 1월6일 윤석열 대통령 체포를 저지하겠다며 한남동 공관 앞에 모였던 국민의힘 의원 44명을 기억하십니까? 대법원이 최종적으로 체포 방해를 유죄로 인정했으니 이들은 이제라도 대국민사과를 하는 것이 옳다고 봅니다. 그런데도 시치미를 뚝 떼고 침묵하고 있습니다. 도대체 부끄러움이라는 것을 전혀 모르는 것 같습니다.)

Second, the Jang Dong-hyuk effect. (둘째, 장동혁 효과입니다.)

The most core value of conservatism is responsibility. Without taking responsibility, it is not conservatism. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk did not take responsibility even for the defeat in the June 3rd election. (보수의 가장 핵심적인 가치는 책임입니다. 책임지지 않으면 보수가 아닙니다. 장동혁 대표는 6·3 선거 패배에도 책임지지 않았습니다.)

The most core attitude of conservatism is dignity. Conservatism without dignity is not conservatism. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, during the 'vote counting station blockade protest' at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul on July 7th, held up a placard that read, "Jae-myung, don't pick on a high school student, fight me." He mocked the incumbent president by using his first name in a disrespectful tone. Next time, he might hold up a placard with profanity. (보수의 가장 핵심적인 태도는 품격입니다. 품격 없는 보수는 보수가 아닙니다. 장동혁 대표는 7월7일 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에서 “재명아 고등학생 말고 나랑 싸우자”고 쓴 팻말을 들었습니다. 현직 대통령의 이름을 부르며 반말로 조롱한 것입니다. 다음에는 욕설을 써서 팻말로 들 수도 있을 것 같습니다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk said this on the New Daily TV YouTube channel on July 10th. (장동혁 대표는 7월10일 뉴데일리 티브이 유튜브에 출연해 이런 말을 했습니다.)

"They talk about not doing 'subtraction politics,' but someone who shoots at our own side is the biggest minus. There is no greater subtraction than that. Telling the party leader to step down is subtraction politics. Clearly, acts of insubordination are like shooting at our own side in a war and helping the enemy." (“뺄셈 정치를 하지 말라고 하는데, 우리 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 사람은 가장 큰 마이너스다. 그보다 더 뺄셈은 없다. 대표한테 당신 물러나라고 하는 게 뺄셈 정치다. 명백한 해당 행위는 전쟁에서 우리 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 것, 그리고 적을 돕는 것이다.”)

"Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon was expelled for criminal acts, not for acts of insubordination." (“한동훈 의원은 범죄 행위로 제명을 당한 것이지, 해당 행위로 제명당한 것이 아니다.”)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's remarks are truly astonishing. Across both ruling and opposition parties, demands for the resignation of party leadership are commonplace. Even in the era of imperial-style chairpersons, demands for leadership resignation were not punished. If Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon's bulletin board controversy was a criminal act, they should not have disciplined him but reported him to investigative authorities to hold him criminally accountable. (장동혁 대표의 발언은 참으로 놀라운 것입니다. 여야를 막론하고 정당에서 지도부 사퇴 요구는 일상사입니다. 제왕적 총재들이 지배하던 시대에도 지도부 사퇴 요구를 징계하지 않았습니다. 한동훈 의원의 게시판 논란이 범죄 행위라면 징계를 할 것이 아니라 수사기관에 고발해서 형사 책임을 묻는 게 마땅합니다.)

The patience of conservative-leaning media also seems to be running out. The title of Kim Dae-jung's column in the July 7th edition of the Chosun Ilbo was, "People Power Party, Let's Go to a Confidence Vote for the Party Leader." The title of its July 7th editorial was, "The Disciplinary Action of the People Power Party Attempts to Defy the Choice of the People from a Month Ago." The title of its July 11th editorial was, "Representative Jang, Is the Choice of Voters in Busan North-Gap a Joke?" (보수 성향 언론의 인내심도 서서히 바닥에 이르고 있는 것 같습니다. 조선일보 7월7일 치 김대중 칼럼의 제목은 “국힘, 당대표 신임투표로 가자”였습니다. 7월7일 치 사설 제목은 “국민의힘 징계, 한 달 전 국민의 선택에 맞서려 한다”였습니다. 7월11일 치 사설 제목은 “장 대표는 부산 북갑 유권자 선택이 우스운 건가”였습니다.)

The title of the July 7th editorial of Munhwa Ilbo was also, "Dozens of Lawmakers Are Subject to Discipline... Should at Least Hold a Confidence Vote for Jang." The Dong-A Ilbo ran a column by Kim Soon-deok on July 9th titled, "Does Jang Dong-hyuk Have the Right to Oppose the 'Gag Law'?" (문화일보 7월7일 치 사설 제목도 “의원 수십 명이 징계 대상이라니…장 신임투표라도 해야”였습니다. 동아일보는 7월9일 치에 “장동혁, ‘입틀막법’ 반대할 자격 있나”라는 제목의 김순덕 칼럼을 실었습니다.)

However, all these advices and reprimands are like 'reading sutras to a cow's ears.' Representative Jang Dong-hyuk appears to have no intention of stepping down. It is said he doesn't even read newspapers. (그러나 이런 충고와 질책이 모두 ‘쇠귀에 경 읽기’입니다. 장동혁 대표는 사퇴할 생각이 전혀 없는 것으로 보입니다. 신문도 아예 읽지 않는 것 같다고 합니다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk has another source of confidence: the hardcore responsible party members of the People Power Party. These hardcore responsible party members of the People Power Party maintain an adversarial, mutually coexisting relationship with the hardcore dues-paying party members of the Democratic Party. It is a tactic of strongly criticizing rivals and holding on based on that hostility and hatred. The paradox of political polarization is that as hostility and hatred deepen, the positions of the extreme wings become more entrenched. (장동혁 대표가 믿는 구석은 따로 있습니다. 국민의힘 강성 책임당원들입니다. 국민의힘 강성 책임당원들은 민주당 강성 권리당원들과 적대적 상호 공존 관계를 맺고 있습니다. 경쟁 상대를 강하게 비판하면서 그 적대감과 증오를 기반으로 버티는 전술입니다. 적대와 증오가 깊어질수록 양극단 세력의 입지는 단단해지는 것이 정치 양극화의 역설입니다.)

A lawmaker from the People Power Party's Yeongnam region constituency described Representative Jang Dong-hyuk this way. (국민의힘의 영남 지역구 한 의원은 장동혁 대표를 이렇게 묘사했습니다.)

"Now, only malice remains. I shouldn't say this, but as some say, if he were a complete corpse, it wouldn't matter, but the problem is he's become a zombie walking around. He is full of spite. I've also memorized 'fraudulent election, re-election, same-day voting, hand-counting' because he says it so much. He is now trapped in that alone." (“지금 악만 남은 거다. 이런 말 하면 안 되지만 누구 말대로 아예 시체면 상관이 없는데 좀비가 돼서 돌아다니니까 문제다. 독기가 가득하다. ‘부정선거 재선거 당일투표 수개표’ 하도 많이 들어서 나도 외웠다. 지금 거기에만 갇혀 있는 거다.”)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk held an on-site briefing on the 'June 3rd Disenfranchisement Incident' in Busan on July 12th. He also visited the assembly site at Seomyeon Heart Plaza on Jungang-daero in Busanjin-gu. He plans to visit Gwangju this week and conclude his local tour schedule in Daegu. I am worried about what placard he will hold up and what he will say. (장동혁 대표는 7월12일 부산에서 ‘6·3 참정권 박탈 사태’ 현장 간담회를 합니다. 부산진구 중앙대로 서면 하트광장 집회 현장도 방문합니다. 이번 주 중 광주를 방문하고 대구에서 지방 순회 일정을 마무리할 예정입니다. 어떤 팻말을 들고 나설지, 무슨 말을 할지 걱정입니다.)

What will ultimately happen to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk? Former People Power Party Emergency Response Committee Chair Kim Jong-in appeared on CBS Radio's 'Park Jae-hong's One Match Show' on July 10th and said this. (장동혁 대표는 결국 어떻게 될까요? 김종인 전 국민의힘 비대위원장은 7월10일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’에 출연해 이렇게 말했습니다.)

"Representative Jang Dong-hyuk says he will never step down even if a resolution to oust him is passed at the general meeting of lawmakers, but if it comes to that, as a politician, he will inevitably experience a very tragic situation. Ultimately, a situation will arise where he steps down due to the power of party members or lawmakers." (“장동혁 대표는 의원총회에서 내쫓는 결의를 해도 절대 안 물러난다고 하지만 그런 상황까지 가면 정치인으로서 굉장히 좀 비극적인 상황을 겪을 수밖에 없을 것이다. 결국 당원이나 의원들의 힘에 의해서 물러나는 그런 상황이 올 것이다.”)

However, contrary to former Chair Kim Jong-in's observation, the likelihood of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk being ousted by party members does not seem very high in the immediate future. (그러나 김종인 전 위원장의 관측처럼 장동혁 대표가 당원들에 의해 쫓겨날 가능성은 당장은 그리 크지 않아 보입니다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk won the final round of the party convention last August with a vote share of 50.27%. Although he lagged far behind candidate Kim Moon-soo in the general public opinion poll, he won by obtaining 52.88% in the party member electoral college vote, which reflected 80%. Most of the responsible party members who supported candidate Jang Dong-hyuk at that time remain. We must also assume that a significant number of the 50,000 Shincheonji followers who joined the People Power Party under the direction of Chairman Lee Man-hee are still there. (장동혁 대표는 지난해 8월 전당대회 결선에서 50.27% 득표율로 승리했습니다. 일반 국민 여론조사에서 김문수 후보에게 크게 뒤졌지만 80%를 반영한 당원 선거인단 투표에서 52.88%를 득표해 승리했습니다. 당시 장동혁 후보를 지지했던 책임당원들이 대부분 그대로 있습니다. 이만희 총회장의 지시로 국민의힘에 입당한 신천지 신도 5만명 가운데 상당수도 그대로 있다고 봐야 합니다.)

If a vote of all party members were held in this state, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk could be reconfirmed. He could even complete his term until August next year and, if he seeks re-election, be re-elected as party leader. What would happen to the People Power Party then? Would its approval ratings rise? There's no way. The People Power Party's approval rating will plummet. A rush of defections among rational conservative-leaning party members will begin. Lawmakers will also defect en masse. (이런 상태에서 전당원투표를 하면 장동혁 대표가 재신임될 수 있습니다. 심지어 내년 8월까지 대표 임기를 마치고 연임에 도전하면 대표로 다시 선출될 수도 있습니다. 그럼 국민의힘은 어떻게 될까요? 지지도가 올라갈까요? 그럴 리가요. 국민의힘 지지도는 수직 낙하할 것입니다. 합리적 보수 성향 당원들의 탈당 러시가 시작될 것입니다. 의원들도 집단 탈당할 것입니다.)

A lawmaker's top priority is to be elected in the next general election. If they remain in the People Power Party under Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's system, defeat is certain, so they will not stay idle. Eventually, the People Power Party will degenerate into a minor party and then disappear. (국회의원의 최우선 목표는 다음 총선에서 당선되는 것입니다. 장동혁 대표 체제의 국민의힘에 남아 있으면 낙선이 분명한데 의원들이 가만히 있을 리 없습니다. 결국 국민의힘은 군소정당으로 전락했다가 사라질 것입니다.)

There is actually a precedent for this. Ahead of the 12th general election on February 12, 1985, the two Kims, Kim Young-sam and Kim Dae-jung, led by Chairman Lee Min-woo, founded the New Korean Democratic Party (NKDP). The NKDP caused a sensation, overtaking the 'government-controlled opposition' Democratic Korea Party and the National Party to become the primary opposition party. (실제로 그런 전례가 있었습니다. 1985년 2·12 12대 총선을 앞두고 김영삼·김대중 양 김 씨는 이민우 총재를 앞세워 신한민주당(신민당)을 창당했습니다. 신민당은 돌풍을 일으켰고 ‘관제 야당’ 민한당과 국민당을 제치고 제1 야당이 됐습니다.)

However, in December 1986, Chairman Lee Min-woo suddenly announced the 'Lee Min-woo Initiative,' conditionally accepting the Chun Doo-hwan regime's constitutional amendment for a cabinet system. In protest, lawmakers from Kim Young-sam's Sangdo-dong faction and Kim Dae-jung's Donggyo-dong faction defected en masse to found the Unification Democratic Party. The NKDP shrunk to about ten seats and then failed to elect a single candidate in the 1988 general election, leading to its registration being cancelled. (그러나 1986년 12월 이민우 총재는 돌연 전두환 정권의 의원내각제 개헌을 조건부로 수용하는 ‘이민우 구상’을 발표했습니다. 이에 반발한 김영삼의 상도동계와 김대중의 동교동계 의원들이 무더기로 탈당해 통일민주당을 창당했습니다. 신민당은 10여석으로 쪼그라들었다가 1988년 총선에서 당선자를 한 명도 내지 못해 등록 취소됐습니다.)

It is not entirely impossible for the People Power Party to seize a chance for revival. If approval ratings continue to fall like this, Supreme Council members Shin Dong-wook and Kim Jae-won might change their stance. If the supreme council members resign, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk must step down. The same applies if Representative Jang Dong-hyuk faces a vote of no confidence in a party-wide ballot. (국민의힘이 회생의 기회를 잡을 가능성이 전혀 없는 것은 아닙니다. 지금처럼 지지도가 계속 떨어지면 신동욱·김재원 최고위원이 태도를 바꿀 수도 있습니다. 최고위원들이 사퇴하면 장동혁 대표는 물러나야 합니다. 전당원투표에서 장동혁 대표가 불신임당해도 마찬가지입니다.)

If that happens, the People Power Party will transition to an Emergency Response Committee system. Ahead of the 2028 general election, an alliance could be formed involving Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, Lawmaker Lee Jun-seok, Lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo, and former Lawmaker Yoo Seung-min. Unlike presidential elections, a kind of collective leadership system is possible for general elections. (그렇게 되면 국민의힘은 비상대책위원회 체제로 넘어갑니다. 2028년 총선을 앞두고 오세훈 서울시장, 한동훈 의원, 이준석 의원, 안철수 의원, 유승민 전 의원 등의 연대가 이뤄질 수 있습니다. 총선은 대선과 달리 일종의 집단지도체제가 가능합니다.)

This is the only way for the People Power Party to become competitive in the 2028 general election. Of course, this is a scenario only possible if Representative Jang Dong-hyuk resigns in any case. This means Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation is the only way to save conservatism. What is your opinion? (국민의힘이 2028년 총선에서 경쟁력을 갖추는 유일한 방안입니다. 물론 어떤 경우든 장동혁 대표가 사퇴해야 가능한 시나리오입니다. 장동혁 대표 사퇴가 보수를 살리는 유일한 길이라는 의미입니다. 여러분은 어떻게 생각하십니까?)

Senior Political Correspondent shy99@hani.co.kr (정치부 선임기자 shy99@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Did you see that, Jaemyung?" Jang Dong-hyuk uses informal speech again... "'Dong-hyuk-a' you wouldn't say" Criticism even within the People Power Party (“재명아 봤지?” 장동혁 또 반말…“‘똥혁아’ 안 하잖아” 국힘서도 비판)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, was spotted holding a sign during the "Jamsil Counting Station Blockade Protest" that read "Did you see that, Jaemyung?" again using informal speech to refer to President Lee Jaemyung. Despite criticism from political circles that referring to the president informally is "inappropriate," he appears unfazed. <<> Representative Jang appeared at the "Counting Station Blockade Protest" in front of the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul on the 11th, holding a sign that read "Did you see that, Jaemyung? Heard it? Then you have to accept a special counsel, right?" Previously, on the 7th, he sparked controversy at the same protest by holding a sign saying "Jaemyung, fight me, not high school students," and this time he wrote, "Did you see that, Jaemyung?" Jang was also seen waving a heart-shaped cheering stick with the Taegeukgi and chanting "Election fraud, re-election, same-day voting, manual recount." <<> Jang was also seen holding signs that said, "Is my vote a joke? You're the joke!", "Olympic Park is hot, right? Wanna hang out with a friend next week?", and "The youth of Olympic Park, the Taegeukgi, the national anthem. This is our future!" Kim Min-soo, a Supreme Council member of the People Power Party, stood next to Jang, holding a sign reading "Olympic Park. There are those who haven't been, but none who came only once," and chanting slogans. Based on the distinctive calligraphy style, all the signs are presumed to have been written by Jang himself. <<> Despite ongoing criticism from political circles over Jang's earlier sign reading "Jaemyung, fight me," Jang appears undeterred, continuing his pattern of "informal speech politics." On the 8th, Representative Park Ji-won of the Democratic Party of Korea pointed out, "Even if harsh words fly back and forth in politics, isn't it a principle to at least show respect to the head of state, the president?" On the 9th, Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, criticized it as "the lowest form of reckless behavior" and said, "Representative Jang's vulgar and abusive politics have crossed the line." <<> Internal criticism within the People Power Party has also emerged. Kim Geun-sik, the head of the Songpa-gu Byeong district party chapter for the People Power Party, said on Facebook on the 11th, "No matter how much the president has done wrong, 'Jaemyung-a' is not the language of politics. It's just the excrement of abusive language spewed by far-right extremists." He added, "No matter how angry I am, I don't mock the leader by calling him 'Dong-hyuk-a'." He continued, "That is the dignity of politics. That is the depth of politics. Please come to your senses and don't be bound by the language of extremists." <<> Yoon Hee-seok, a former spokesperson for the People Power Party and a member of the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, also evaluated the sign as "inappropriate" on the 8th during MBC Radio's "Jo Seung-won's News High Kick." He added, "Even just calling (the president) by his name is considered a derogatory term. When you mix derogatory terms while making an argument against a political opponent, regardless of how reasonable the argument's content is, it doesn't register. Only the derogatory terms come through." <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 ‘잠실 개표소 봉쇄 시위’에서 “재명아 봤지”라며 재차 반말로 이재명 대통령을 지칭하는 손팻말을 들고 있는 모습이 포착됐다. 이 대통령을 향한 반말 호명에 정치권에서 “부적절하다”는 비판들이 나왔지만, 아랑곳하지 않는 모양새다.)

item.title: North Korea Vows to “Continue Safeguarding North Korea-China Common Interests”… Reports on Pak Thae-song-Li Qiang Talks (북한 “북-중 공동이익 수호 계속”…박태성-리창 회담 보도)
item.description:
On the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty), North Korean Cabinet Premier Pak Thae-song, currently visiting China, discussed matters concerning the development of North Korea-China exchange and cooperation with Chinese Premier Li Qiang, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 12th. (북중 우호협력 및 상호원조 조약(북중 우호조약) 체결 65돌 맞아 중국을 방문 중인 박태성 북한 내각총리가 리창 중국 국무원 총리와 북중 교류협력 발전에 관한 사안을 논의했다고 12일 조선중앙통신이 보도했다.)

The agency reported that Premier Pak held talks with Premier Li the previous day at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where “issues related to expanding and developing exchanges and cooperation in various fields based on the agreements reached during the historic summit in Pyongyang between the top leaders of North Korea and China were discussed.” KCNA said that during the talks, Premier Pak referred to the North Korea-China Friendship Treaty as “a solid political and legal guarantee that strongly promotes the development of friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries,” adding that “the complex international political situation demands that the spirit of the treaty, centered on unity, cooperation, and the protection of common interests, continue to be highly upheld.” <<> Premier Li also emphasized that “China and North Korea are neighboring countries sharing a common destiny, protecting and helping each other,” and stressed the need to “continue upholding the spirit of the (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty), maintain close high-level exchanges, and expand and develop political mutual trust and practical cooperation.” <<> Last month, Chairman Kim Jong-un and President Xi Jinping held a summit in Pyongyang, pledging exchange and cooperation in diplomatic, military, and economic fields, along with high-level exchanges. With Premier Pak’s visit to China as an opportunity, it was anticipated that economic cooperation measures, such as Chinese tourism to North Korea, the opening of the new Yalu River Bridge, and the expansion of border trade ports, would be discussed. <<> KCNA also reported that Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi exchanged congratulatory messages on the 11th. According to KCNA, Minister Choe expressed to Minister Wang “the willingness to further strengthen communication and cooperation between the foreign ministries to highly uphold the noble intentions of the top leaders of North Korea and China and to develop the North Korea-China friendly cooperative relationship into the most robust and strategic example of relations between socialist countries.” Minister Wang also stated in the message that “China is willing to firmly implement the important common understanding of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries and to continuously strive to consolidate, deepen, and develop the traditional China-North Korea friendly cooperative relationship.” <<> KCNA also reported that Premier Pak and the North Korean delegation, currently visiting Beijing, participated in a welcoming ceremony on the 11th. On the Chinese side, Premier Li, along with State Council member and Secretary-General of the State Council Wu Zhenglong, Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission Zheng Shanjie, and Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao, received the delegation. Premier Pak, along with Workers’ Party of Korea Central Committee Secretary Kim Song-nam and other members of the North Korean delegation, reviewed the honor guard of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army together with Premier Li. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (통신은 박 총리가 전날 베이징 인민대회당에서 리 총리와 회담하고 “조중 최고수뇌분들께서 역사적인 평양 상봉에서 이룩하신 합의에 따라 각 분야에서 교류와 협력을 확대, 발전시켜 나가기 위한 문제들이 토의되었다”고 보도했다. 회담에서 박 총리는 북중 우호조약이 “두 나라 사이의 친선협조 관계 발전을 강력히 추동해 나가는 굳건한 정치적 및 법률적 담보”라며 “복잡다단한 국제정치 정세는 단결과 협조, 공동의 이익 수호를 핵(핵심)으로 하는 조약의 정신을 계속 높이 발양해 나갈 것을 요구하고 있다”고 말했다고 통신은 보도했다.)

item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo: "I oppose Han Dong-hoon's return to the party, he shouldn't even come near... If he forms a new party, I'll cheer him on." (안철수 “한동훈 복당 반대, 얼씬도 말라…창당한다면 응원”)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo stated on the 12th, "I formally oppose the return of Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon to the People Power Party." This is a response to Han's accusations of "false incitement" regarding his recent testimony at the trial of Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho, who faces charges of engaging in critical duties related to insurrection. Some interpret this as the beginning of a competition for conservative leadership. (안철수 국민의힘 의원이 12일 “한동훈 (무소속) 의원의 국민의힘 복당을 공식적으로 반대한다”고 말했다. 최근 추경호 대구시장의 내란중요임무종사 혐의 재판에 출석해 증언한 것과 관련, 한 의원이 “거짓 선동”이라고 몰아붙인 데 대한 반응인데 이를 계기로 보수 주도권 경쟁을 벌이는 것이란 해석도 나온다.)

During a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Ahn said, "After testifying as a witness in Mayor Choo's trial this time, I have encountered reactions I never imagined. Lawmaker Han has framed me as if I engaged in distortion and incitement. Turning testimony that stated facts into falsehoods is a clear case of spreading false information and defamation," he argued. (안 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “이번에 추 시장 재판에 증인으로 진술한 후 상상도 하지 못했던 반응을 접했다”며 “한 의원은 마치 제가 왜곡과 선동을 한 것처럼 몰아갔다. 사실을 사실대로 말한 증언을 허위로 둔갑시키는 것이야말로 명백한 허위사실 유포이자 명예훼손”이라고 반발했다.)

On the 8th, Ahn appeared as a witness at Mayor Choo's trial at the Seoul Central District Court and testified, "I heard that it was (then-leader) Han Dong-hoon who first suggested gathering at the party headquarters because police were blocking access to the National Assembly. Choo Kyung-ho simply went along with that call to gather at the party headquarters." He added, "It is not true that then-leader Han said to gather at the National Assembly, but then-floor leader Choo Kyung-ho ignored that and ordered people to the party headquarters." In response, Han had refuted this on the 9th, stating, "Just because time has passed, there should be no attempts to distort objective facts. It seems he is distorting what happened at 12 o'clock to fit what happened at 11 o'clock." (안 의원은 지난 8일 서울중앙지방법원에서 열린 추 시장의 재판에 증인으로 나와 “경찰이 국회 출입을 막고 있으니 당사로 모이자고 먼저 한 게 한동훈 (당시) 대표라고 들었다”며 “추경호는 그에 맞춰 당사로 모이라고 한 것”이라고 증언했다. 그러면서 “한동훈 대표가 국회에 모이라고 했는데 추경호 (당시) 원내대표가 이를 무시하고 당사로 모이라고 했다는 것은 사실이 아니다”라고 했다. 이에 대해 한 의원은 지난 9일 “시간이 지났다고 객관적 사실들을 왜곡하려는 시도가 있어선 안 된다”며 “11시에 있었던 일을 12시에 맞춰 왜곡해 말씀하시는 것 같다”고 반박한 바 있다.)

Regarding Han's rebuttal, Ahn told reporters that same day, "I have not confused the time at all. I can show all the evidence of what the party's official records say and what I was doing at what time." Ahn said, "In fact, despite being summoned as a witness multiple times in the same trial, Han himself has not appeared even once. If he has something to say, he should stop hiding behind an 'absence from home' excuse and appear in court to testify." (안 의원은 이날 기자들과 만나 한 의원의 반박에 대해 “저는 전혀 (시간을) 혼동하지 않았다. 당의 공식 자료와 내가 몇 시에 뭘 했는지 자료를 전부 보여줄 수 있다”고 말했다. 안 의원은 “정작 한 의원 본인은 같은 재판에 증인으로 수차례나 소환되고도 단 한 번도 출석하지 않았다. 할 말이 있다면 ‘폐문부재’ 뒤에 숨지 말고 법정에 출석해서 증언하면 될 일”이라고 말했다.)

Ahn further stated, "Even while Han is outside the party, this is the level of trouble. It's as clear as day what would happen if he returns to the party. The entire party would fall into factional strife and exhausting internal conflict, and the damage would be borne entirely by the conservative and right-wing citizens. The election victory would be unattainable, and we would spiral into a situation of catastrophe." Ahn added toward Han, "Now, please don't even think about coming near our party. If you're considering forming a new party, I'll cheer you on." (안 의원은 그러면서 “한 의원이 당 밖에 있는데도 이 정도인데, 그가 복당하면 어떻게 될지 불 보듯 뻔하다”며 “당 전체는 계파 갈등과 소모적 내전에 빠질 것이며, 그 피해는 고스란히 보수 및 우파 시민 전체가 떠안게 될 것이다. 총선 승리는 엄두도 못 내는, 파국의 상황으로 치달을 것”이라고 주장했다. 안 의원은 한 의원을 향해 “이제 우리 당에는 얼씬도 하지 말기 바란다. 혹시 창당을 생각하고 있다면 응원하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Moo-sung "Jang Dong-hyuk is taking to the streets because he has no place in the party" (김무성 “장동혁, 당에 설 자리 없어서 장외로 도는 것”)
item.description:
Former leader of the Saenuri Party (predecessor to the People Power Party), Kim Moo-sung, criticized recent nationwide tours of the suffrage rally by current People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, saying, "The party leader is taking to the streets because he has no place to stand in the party." (김무성 새누리당(국민의힘 전신) 전 대표가 최근 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 참정권 집회 전국 순회와 관련해 “당 대표가 당에 설 자리가 없으니까 장외로 도는 것”이라고 비판했다.)

Appearing on TV Chosun’s 'Strong Opponents' on the 11th, the former leader Kim addressed Jang’s multiple attendances at the suffrage rally held at Seoul Olympic Park, where he wore a hat and mask, stating, "Even if he attends the rally wearing a hat and mask, he is still the current party leader," and added, "The public sees everything Jang Dong-hyuk says and does outside as the words and actions of the People Power Party leader. I urge him to exercise restraint." (김 전 대표는 지난 11일 티브이(TV)조선 ‘강적들’에 출연해 장 대표가 서울 올림픽공원에서 열리는 참정권 집회에 모자와 마스크를 쓰고 여러 차례 참석한 데 대해 “모자, 마스크를 쓰고 집회에 나간다 하더라도 현직 당 대표자”라며 “국민은 장동혁 대표가 장외에 나가서 하는 모든 언행을 국민의힘 대표의 언행으로 본다. 자제해달라”고 했다.)

He continued, "I believe there was no election fraud," and said, "Our party has been deeply divided because of those obsessed with election fraud delusions. Just as things were being somewhat sorted out, the unprecedented shortage of ballot papers reignited (the election fraud claims)." (그는 이어 “부정선거는 없다고 생각한다”며 “우리 당이 부정선거 망상론자들 때문에 굉장히 분열됐다. 어느 정도 정리되는 과정에 이번 투표용지 부족사태라는 있을 수 없는 일이 벌어지면서 (부정선거론이) 다시 불붙었다”고 했다.)

Former leader Kim also criticized the disciplinary drive against pro-Han (Han Dong-hoon) and anti-Jang Dong-hyuk lawmakers. (김 전 대표는 또 친한계와 반장동혁계 의원들에 대한 징계 드라이브도 비판했다.)

He said, "Leader Jang doesn’t have the power to impose discipline. He has already lost his leadership," and added, "In the end, he keeps moving toward the path that hastens his own downfall." (그는 “장 대표가 징계할 수 있는 힘이 없다. 이미 지도력을 잃었다”며 “결국 자기 명을 재촉하는 길을 자꾸 가고 있다”고 했다.)

He further stated, "The party’s ethics committee disciplined lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin and former supreme council member Kim Jong-hyuk, but the court didn’t accept it. If so, the ethics committee that made the mistaken discipline should be disbanded, and those (ethics committee members) should be disciplined instead. But for that same group to again impose discipline solely for the party leader’s benefit is ultimately dividing the party," adding, "As a result, (Leader Jang) himself could face discipline." He also said, "Han Dong-hoon should be reinstated into the party, and (the party) should merge with Lee Jun-seok (leader of the Reform Party). Aren’t they people who were unjustly expelled?" (이어 “당 윤리위가 배현진 의원과 김종혁 전 최고위원을 징계했는데 법원에서 받아들이지 않았다. 그러면 잘못된 징계를 한 윤리위를 해산하고 오히려 그 사람(윤리위원)들을 징계해야 하는데 그 멤버가 그대로 또다시 당 대표만을 위한 징계를 하겠다는 것은 결국 당을 분열시키는 것”이라며 “결과적으로 (장 대표) 본인이 징계를 당할 수 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “한동훈은 복당시켜야 하고 이준석(개혁신당 대표)과는 합당해야 한다. 부당하게 쫓겨난 사람들 아니냐”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] One missing naval crew member... 50 km off the coast of Gyeongjin, East Sea ([속보] 해군 함정 승조원 1명 실종…동해 거진 50㎞ 해상)
item.description:
The Navy announced on the morning of the 12th that one crew member from a naval vessel, which was conducting patrol duties approximately 50 km east of Gyeongjin in the East Sea, has gone missing. (해군이 12일 오전 동해 거진 동방 50여㎞ 해상에서 경비임무를 수행 중이던 해군 함정 승조원 1명이 실종됐다고 밝혔다.)

The Navy added, "We are currently deploying ships and aircraft in coordination with the Coast Guard to search for the missing person," and "We are also disseminating the situation to fishing vessels operating in the area and nearby commercial ships to cooperate in the search." (해군은 “현재 해경과 합동으로 함정과 항공기를 투입하여 실종자를 탐색 중”이라며 “조업 중인 어선, 인근 상선 등에도 상황을 전파하고 수색을 협조하고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Ministry of National Defense reported that Minister of National Ahn Gyu-baek received a report on the incident this morning and "instructed that all efforts be made to rescue the missing person as quickly and safely as possible, while maintaining an active cooperative system with relevant agencies such as the Coast Guard." (안규백 국방부 장관도 이날 오전 사고 관련 보고를 받고 “최대한 신속하고 안전하게 실종자 구조에 최선을 다할 것과 해경 등 유관기관과도 적극적인 공조체계를 유지할 것을 지시했다”고 국방부는 전했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cho Kuk shouts "Risense, yahoo!" – "I never said Risense is about Ilbe" (“리센느 야호!” 외친 조국 “리센느 일베라 한 적 없어”)
item.description:
Amid controversy over whether girl group Risense member Woni's remark "Museopno" was an "Ilbe-style expression" (referencing the far-right online community Ilbe), former leader of the Innovation Party Cho Kuk stated, "I never said Risense is about Ilbe," and added, "I regret that my writing was used as an opportunity to hurt Risense and its fans." (걸그룹 리센느 멤버 원이가 “무섭노”라고 말한 것을 두고 ‘일베(일간베스트저장소)식 표현’ 논란이 일었던 가운데 조국 전 조국혁신당 대표가 “리센느가 일베라고 말한 적이 전혀 없다”며 “제 글이 리센느와 팬 여러분께 상처를 주는 계기로 활용돼 유감”이라고 했다.)

On the 12th, former leader Cho posted on Facebook: "My heart was heavy due to the aftermath of my raising an issue about the use of Ilbe-style 'no'—which looks similar to the Gyeongsang dialect but is clearly different. What I lamented was the spread, without any criticism, of the Ilbe-style 'no' that began with mocking former President Roh Moo-hyun across our society and the tolerance of this phenomenon." (조 전 대표는 12일 페이스북에 “경상도 말과 유사해 보이지만 분명히 다른, 일베식 ‘노’ 사용에 대한 저의 문제 제기의 여파로 마음이 무거웠다”며 “제가 개탄했던 것은 고 노무현 대통령님을 조롱하는 데서 시작된 일베식 ‘노’ 사용이 아무런 비판 없이 우리 사회 전반으로 확산되고 이를 묵인하는 현상이었다”고 했다.)

Former leader Cho said, "However, I found that my raising this issue was being interpreted as criticism of Risense. I never mentioned or targeted Risense in any of my writings. I never said that Risense is about Ilbe." He continued, "I am very sorry and regret that my writing was used as an opportunity to hurt Risense and its fans. Also, after listening to my daughter and young staff members, I have come to reflect on the need to pay more careful attention to the language and culture of the younger generation and the context in which it is used. I applaud Risense's struggles and achievements and sincerely hope they receive even more love on bigger stages in the future." Former leader Cho added, "Risense, yahoo!" <<> Earlier, on the 5th, former leader Cho had posted on Facebook: "There are people who defend the use of 'no' at the end of interrogative sentences by Ilbe, which began as a way to mock President Roh Moo-hyun, claiming it is also used in Busan and the Yeongnam region. From my observation, Ilbe mechanically attaches 'no' to standard language." Prior to that, a YouTube video released on the 28th of last month showed Woni, who is from Geoje City in South Gyeongsang Province, saying "Museopno," sparking controversy over whether it was an Ilbe-style expression. Cho's remarks had amplified the controversy. <<> Regarding former leader Cho's statement of "regret," People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jeon criticized him on Facebook that day, saying, "And now you say you never said Risense is about Ilbe?" Kim added, "Let all the Wonis not lose heart and walk proudly!" <<> Choi Eun-seok, the senior deputy spokesperson for the People Power Party's floor leadership, also issued a commentary titled "Stop your petty excuses, former leader Cho, and restrain yourself," criticizing Cho's remarks as "sophistry." Deputy spokesperson Choi said, "The member of Risense suffered unexpected hardship due to this controversy sparked by former leader Cho.
